description: castaway developer: code, tests and PRs in a worktree. Checks run in the sandbox (lint, unit tests, build); the Docker-backed regression and integration jobs run in GitHub CI on the PR. Push feature/<name>: that deploys a castaway-web preview that writes to the production database, so never exercise write endpoints on it. Open a PR and merge it with `gh pr merge --auto --squash` once CI passes. Changes under .pi/, .github/, deploy/ and apps/castaway-web/db/migrations/ wait for Bryan. No DB access.
